name: My Tho
provinceNote: Since 2025, five wards of Đồng Tháp: Mỹ Tho, Đạo Thạnh, Mỹ Phong, Thới Sơn, and Trung An. The government directory gives 23 đường 30/4, phường Mỹ Tho.
dotReason: Worth a night when the Tiền is the trip
summary: A Mekong Delta river town on the Tien River, about 70 km from Ho Chi Minh City. Walk the riverside promenade, visit Vinh Trang pagoda, take a boat to Thoi Son for the orchards, coconut candy, and folk music, and eat the town’s own hu tieu noodle soup. A day and a night suits first-time visitors to the delta.
fee: Vĩnh Tràng, Bửu Lâm, Quan Đế, and Bảo tàng Tiền Giang are free. The electric cart is 40,000 VND on route 1 and 30,000 VND on route 2, 07:00–22:00. Boat fare, coach fare, motorbike fare, and taxi fare: Check on arrival.
getThere: 70 km and about 1 hour on the Ho Chi Minh City–Trung Lương expressway, or 66 km and 1.7 hours toward Mỹ Tho, and 67 km and 1.7 hours toward Sài Gòn. The Sài Gòn–Mỹ Tho railway ran from 1885 and stopped in 1958, about 70 km. A Ho Chi Minh City–Cần Thơ line is still in pre-feasibility, 175.2 km, with no Mỹ Tho station named. No passenger train. Minutes from Tân Sơn Nhất: Check on arrival. Fares: Check on arrival.
seoTitle: My Tho travel guide — Thoi Son orchards, coconut candy, folk music
seoDescription: A morning boat to cù lao Thới Sơn for the orchards, coconut candy, and đờn ca tài tử, then hủ tiếu Mỹ Tho and the embankment on đường 30 Tháng 4.
intro: You step off the boat onto cù lao Thới Sơn, fruit trees over the path and a sampan in the nipa, with coconut candy and đờn ca tài tử at the garden house. The Tiền is the water you just crossed. Back on the town bank you are on the embankment along đường 30 Tháng 4, boats on the river and vườn hoa Lạc Hồng at Trưng Trắc.

Stay the night if that river, and the morning on Thới Sơn, is the trip. The four islets are not one island. Lân is cù lao Thới Sơn, in phường Thới Sơn, 6 km from the city. Phụng is Tân Thạch, on the Ben Tre bank. Cầu Rạch Miễu carries National Route 60. The project is 8,331 m and the bridge 2,878 m, and the main bridge is also 2,868 m with the same 8,331 m overall. The usual river day continues to Ben Tre, with Cái Bè, Rạch Gầm – Xoài Mút, Tân Thành, and Gò Công.

Chùa Vĩnh Tràng, on Nguyễn Trung Trực in phường Mỹ Phong, is the morning after the boat. Allow 120 minutes. The gate is free, and the hours are 06:00 to 23:00. The pier is 1.96 km away, at số 01 Hoàng Sa, and the boat does not leave from the pagoda. The Thủ Khoa Huân statue stands in the garden where the old Sài Gòn–Mỹ Tho station stood. The rails stopped in 1958. In 2025 the old city became five wards of Đồng Tháp. The old city was 81.54 km² and 204 thousand people in September 2009.
gettingAround: From Ho Chi Minh City the road is 70 km and about 1 hour on the Ho Chi Minh City–Trung Lương expressway, by bus, and also 66 km and 1.7 hours toward Mỹ Tho, with 67 km and 1.7 hours toward Sài Gòn. No airport sits in the Mỹ Tho wards. Travelers who fly use Tân Sơn Nhất and then that road.

There is no passenger train. The Sài Gòn–Mỹ Tho railway ran from 1885 and stopped in 1958, about 70 km. On 10 October 2025 that was still the account. A Ho Chi Minh City–Cần Thơ line is still in pre-feasibility, 175.2 km, with no Mỹ Tho station named. The old station site is vườn hoa Lạc Hồng, on đường 30/4 and đường Trưng Trắc.
The intercity bus station is on đường Ấp Bắc. The base itself is a walk along đường 30 Tháng 4 and đường dọc kè sông Tiền.

The electric cart parks at Cảng du thuyền Mỹ Tho, số 01 Hoàng Sa, phường Mỹ Tho. Two loops, each 7,000 m and 20–30 minutes, 07:00–22:00 every day. Route 1 is 40,000 VND a guest and passes the pier, Cầu Quay, Nhà Bạch Công Tử on Đinh Bộ Lĩnh, Chùa Vĩnh Tràng, the museum, and Vincom Plaza Mỹ Tho on Hùng Vương. Route 2 is 30,000 VND. The phone is 0273 3.636.868. Confirm the price at the pier. Vincom is a named mall stop. Nhà Bạch Công Tử is a named stop on Đinh Bộ Lĩnh.

stayAreas.name: Đường 30 Tháng 4
stayAreas.summary: A river room in phường Mỹ Tho, facing the Tiền and vườn hoa Lạc Hồng. On Thới Sơn the garden stays use thatch, wood, and a wharf. Named lodges are not picks.

eat: Hủ tiếu Mỹ Tho is the bowl, at breakfast, lunch, or supper. Dry, the strands are tossed with pork crackling, fried shallot, and soy, then topped with cooked minced pork. With broth, the old phường 9 bowl adds sliced pork, liver, intestines, shrimp, squid, and quail egg. One serving uses fresh bean sprouts, lime, chili, and soy, and leaves off lettuce, vinegar, and a herb plate. Fresh greens are also put on the soup bowl.

On Thới Sơn the table is fried elephant-ear fish, grilled snakehead, ginger honey tea, handmade coconut candy, and đờn ca tài tử. The Mỹ Phong village sells bánh tét, bánh ít, bánh hỏi, and bánh tầm. The pier court on 30 Tháng 4, as given on 5 January 2019, sits inside the tourist-boat pier, 3,000 m², from 18:30 to 02:00. A night market at số 8 đường 30/4 runs from 18:00, busiest 19:00–22:00.
interestsBody: Hủ tiếu Mỹ Tho is the bowl. Thới Sơn adds the fried fish, the honey tea, the coconut candy, and the music. Gò Công mắm is a different town.
Vĩnh Tràng is the pagoda. Bửu Lâm and Quan Đế are free and stay in the morning if you have the hour.
The embankment and the Thủ Khoa Huân statue are the evening pin. The old station is a memory. No train runs.

interestGroups.title: Dining and F&B
interestGroups.summary: The town bowl is hủ tiếu, dry or with broth, any meal of the day.
body: Order hủ tiếu Mỹ Tho in town or at the pier court on 30 Tháng 4. The bowl is breakfast, lunch, and supper. The workshop at ấp Hội Gia, phường Mỹ Phong, is where the sheets are made. It is not the address of the bowl.

Thới Sơn puts fried elephant-ear fish, grilled snakehead, ginger honey tea, handmade coconut candy, and đờn ca tài tử on the garden visit. Mỹ Phong adds bánh tét, bánh ít, bánh hỏi, and bánh tầm. The pier court lists chè, sinh tố, and sâm bổ lượng.

cards.title: Dining and F&B
cards.summary: Hủ tiếu Mỹ Tho, dry or with broth, plus the Thới Sơn table and the Mỹ Phong cakes.

interestGroups.title: Pagodas of the old town
interestGroups.summary: A morning at Vĩnh Tràng after the boat.
body: Chùa Vĩnh Tràng is the ceramic gate, the seated Buddha, and the hall. The gate is free, 06:00–23:00, and the visit is 120 minutes.

Chùa Bửu Lâm, at 162 Nguyễn Văn Giác, is also free, with 07:00–18:00 and the year 1742. Other hours are 07:30–11:30 and 13:30–17:30, the year 1803, and two addresses. The year is also 1802, and the address 162B. Chùa Quan Đế, at 31 Đinh Bộ Lĩnh, is free and 07:00–18:00.

cards.title: Vinh Trang Pagoda
cards.summary: The ceramic gate and the hall, on a 120-minute morning. The gate is free.

interestGroups.title: The garden on the Tien
interestGroups.summary: The evening walk uses the statue and the embankment. The station is a memory.
body: The Thủ Khoa Huân statue and vườn hoa Lạc Hồng sit at đường 30/4 and Trưng Trắc, old phường 1, now phường Mỹ Tho. The old station stood here. Walk it late afternoon.

After dark the pier food court is open from 18:30 to 02:00. A night market at số 8 đường 30/4 runs from 18:00, busiest 19:00–22:00. 288 Club at 288 Phạm Thanh, old Phường 5, is 20:00–02:00. That ward is now inside phường Đạo Thạnh.

cards.title: Thu Khoa Huan statue
cards.summary: The pin of the embankment, in the garden where the old station stood. No train runs.

interestGroups.title: Shopping
interestGroups.summary: Coconut candy and honey from Thới Sơn, and the night stalls on đường 30 Tháng 4.

blocks.heading: Thới Sơn to carry home
paragraphs: Handmade coconut candy and ginger honey tea are the OCOP line on cù lao Thới Sơn, tasted with the orchard fruit and đờn ca tài tử. The Mỹ Phong village sells bánh tét, bánh ít, bánh hỏi, and bánh tầm.

blocks.heading: The pier night market
paragraphs: The night market at số 8 đường 30/4 runs from 18:00, busiest 19:00–22:00. The pier court inside the tourist-boat pier is 3,000 m², from 18:30 to 02:00.

cards.title: Thới Sơn candy
cards.summary: Handmade coconut candy and honey from the orchard islet, with the night stalls back on đường 30 Tháng 4.

faqs.q: How far is My Tho from Ho Chi Minh City?
faqs.a: 70 km and about 1 hour on the Trung Lương expressway, or 66 km and 1.7 hours toward Mỹ Tho, and 67 km and 1.7 hours toward Sài Gòn. There is no passenger train.
The road is 1 hour or 1.7 hours, so a same-day return reaches the town. The boat to Thới Sơn has to be the morning, not the hour you arrive. Sleep on đường 30 Tháng 4 if the embankment is the night.
Vĩnh Tràng, Bửu Lâm, Quan Đế, and Bảo tàng Tiền Giang are free. The cart is a separate ticket: 40,000 VND on route 1 and 30,000 VND on route 2.

faqs.q: Is My Tho still in Tien Giang?
faqs.a: The old city is five wards of Đồng Tháp: Mỹ Tho, Đạo Thạnh, Mỹ Phong, Thới Sơn, and Trung An. The working address is 23 đường 30/4, phường Mỹ Tho, tỉnh Đồng Tháp.

season.label: Dry from December
season.note: The dry season starts in December and the rain in May. The average is 28°C, humidity 79.2%, and rain 1,500 mm. The hủ tiếu festival ran 27–31 Dec 2024 at Công viên Tết Mậu Thân, and also until the solar New Year of 2025. That festival is part of the 345th year of the town, 1679–2024. The settlement story also starts in 1623.
